newsitem.title: USA: Avic Group names Pastino CFO.
newsitem.headline: Avic Group names Pastino CFO.

text.p: AVIC Group International said Wednesday it named Albert Pastino as senior vice president and chief financial officer.
Pastino was most recently with Kohlberg & Company, a private equity investment company based in Mt. Kisco, New York.
Executive vice president Michael Lim was formerly chief financial officer. He remains executive vice president.
AVIC also named James O'Brien senior vice president and general counsel, a new position.
